description: Implementation of the Project on Advancing Sustainable Trade between the European Union and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The European Union has extended its willingness to implement a Project on Advancing Sustainable Trade between the European Union and Sri Lanka. Implementation of the said project envisages the objectives such as strengthening sustainable trade linkages between Sri Lanka and the European Union through promoting green transition initiatives and climate-resilient trade practices, improving trade-related institutional capacities and supporting Sri Lanka’s efforts to promote compliance with the international standards required for accessing the European Union market. The Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Food Security, and Co-operative Development has planned to implement the proposed project within a period of four years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development to sign the Financial Grant Agreement between the European Union and the Government of Sri Lanka for obtaining a grant of Euro 10 million for the implementation of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.
